The added plating will push these diameters oversize and destroy the intended fit; the designer must reduce the pre-plate dimensions by the expected coating thickness or specify masking of the bearing seats.","recommended_correction":"Reduce the nominal sizes of the g6 sections by the maximum plating build-up, or add a note to mask these surfaces before plating."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )
3) ORIENTAION OF KEYWAY TO BE MAINTAIN w.r.t. TO CLAMPING HOLES."}],"comment":"Note N2 specifies toughening to 24-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (before or after machining, before or after surface treatment). Without a defined sequence the machinist cannot plan operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or damage to tooling; the designer should add the process stage to the heat-treatment note." ,"recommended_correction":"Update note N2 to state when the heat treatment is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment."}]}
